name: Antigravity
description: Adds gravity to most UI elements

enabled.name: Enable Antigravity
enabled.description: Add gravity to most UI elements

gravity-x.name: Gravity (x)
gravity-x.description: Gravity in the x-axis, where positive x points right.

gravity-y.name: Gravity (y)
gravity-y.description: Gravity in the y-axis, where positive y points up.

pause-antigravity.name: Pause (or resume) Antigravity
pause-antigravity.descriptions: The keybind to pause (or resume) antigravity

poke-antigravity.name: Cause the elements to bounce
poke-antigravity.descriptions: The keybind to bounce elements controlled by antigravity
